question: Register the database

question: Identify all material batches consumed by manufacturing operations that are part of work orders with a priority level greater than 3, and calculate the total consumption quantity for each batch.
sql: SELECT graph.MaterialBatch_id, graph.total_consumed FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('manufacturing_production_process', 'MATCH (wb:WorkOrder)-[:TRIGGERS]->(mo:ManufacturingOperation)-[c:CONSUMES]->(mb:MaterialBatch) WHERE wb.priority_level > 3 GROUP BY mb.MaterialBatch_id RETURN mb.MaterialBatch_id, SUM(c.consumption_quantity) AS total_consumed') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(MaterialBatch_id INT PATH '$[0]', total_consumed INT PATH '$[1]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_production_process', 'MATCH (wb:WorkOrder)-[:TRIGGERS]->(mo:ManufacturingOperation)-[c:CONSUMES]->(mb:MaterialBatch) WHERE wb.priority_level > 3 GROUP BY mb.MaterialBatch_id RETURN mb.MaterialBatch_id, SUM(c.consumption_quantity) AS total_consumed')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_production_process', 'MATCH (wo:WorkOrder)-[:TRIGGERS]->(mo:ManufacturingOperation)-[:CONSUMES]->(mb:MaterialBatch) WHERE wo.priority_level > 3 GROUP BY mb.material_type RETURN mb.material_type AS material_type, SUM(mb.quantity) AS total_quantity_consumed')

question: Count the number of work orders per status that trigger manufacturing operations which consume material batches with an expiration date before today, grouped by work order status.
sql: SELECT graph.work_order_status, graph.count_of_work_orders FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('manufacturing_production_process', 'MATCH (wo:WorkOrder)-[:TRIGGERS]->(mo:ManufacturingOperation)-[:CONSUMES]->(mb:MaterialBatch) WHERE mb.expiration_date < ''2026-06-08'' GROUP BY wo.status RETURN wo.status AS work_order_status, COUNT(wo) AS count_of_work_orders') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(work_order_status VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', count_of_work_orders INT PATH '$[1]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_production_process', 'MATCH (wo:WorkOrder)-[:TRIGGERS]->(mo:ManufacturingOperation)-[:CONSUMES]->(mb:MaterialBatch) WHERE mb.expiration_date < ''2026-06-08'' GROUP BY wo.status RETURN wo.status AS work_order_status, COUNT(wo) AS count_of_work_orders')

question: Find the average standard duration of manufacturing operations that are verified by quality checkpoints with 'Critical' frequency requirements and are defined by products using bill of materials version 'v3.0'.
sql: SELECT graph.avg_standard_duration FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('manufacturing_production_process', 'MATCH (bom:BillOfMaterials{version:''v3.0''})<-[:USES_BOM]-(p:Product)<-[:DEFINED_BY]-(wo:WorkOrder)-[:TRIGGERS]->(mo:ManufacturingOperation)<-[:VERIFIES_AGAINST]-(qc:QualityCheckpoint) WHERE qc.frequency_requirements = ''Critical'' RETURN AVG(mo.standard_duration) AS avg_standard_duration') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(avg_standard_duration DOUBLE PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_production_process', 'MATCH (bom:BillOfMaterials{version:''v3.0''})<-[:USES_BOM]-(p:Product)<-[:DEFINED_BY]-(wo:WorkOrder)-[:TRIGGERS]->(mo:ManufacturingOperation)<-[:VERIFIES_AGAINST]-(qc:QualityCheckpoint) WHERE qc.frequency_requirements = ''Critical'' RETURN AVG(mo.standard_duration) AS avg_standard_duration')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_production_process', 'MATCH (ps:ProductionStation)<-[:PROCESSED_AT]-(mo:ManufacturingOperation)-[:REQUIRES]->(er:EquipmentResource) WHERE er.capacity_rating < 20 GROUP BY ps.location_code RETURN ps.location_code, COUNT(mo) AS operation_count')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_production_process', 'MATCH (wo:WorkOrder)-[:TRIGGERS]->(mo:ManufacturingOperation)-[:CONSUMES]->(mb:MaterialBatch), (mo)-[:REQUIRES]->(er:EquipmentResource) WHERE mb.material_type = ''Steel Alloy'' AND wo.priority_level > 5 RETURN AVG(er.capacity_rating) AS avg_capacity_rating')
